## #177 摘要

**现象**：`vinput-gui` → LLM → 编辑场景，「提供者 / 模型」两个 `QComboBox` 在 KDE Breeze 下只贴合内容（约 90px，`text-cleaner` 被截成 `-cleaner`），同一表单里的 ID / 标签 / 提示词却能拉满宽。

**环境**：Arch + Plasma 6.7.4 + Qt 6.11.2 + Breeze + Wayland。作者对照过 Fusion：Fusion 下是全宽。

**定位是对的。** `src/gui/pages/llm/llm_page.cpp` 里 `onSceneAdd()` / `onSceneEdit()` 都是裸 `new QFormLayout()`，没设 `fieldGrowthPolicy`，于是落到当前 QStyle 的 `SH_FormLayoutFieldGrowthPolicy`：

| 样式 | 策略 | 下拉框 |
|---|---|---|
| Breeze | `ExpandingFieldsGrow` | 不拉。`QComboBox` 默认 `Preferred`（有 Grow 无 Expand） |
| Fusion | `AllNonFixedFieldsGrow` | 拉满 |

所以不是 Wayland / Qt 6.11 回归，是主题差异。`v2.3.17..HEAD` 的 `src/gui/` 也没动过这段布局。

**建议修法（issue 方案 A，一行）**：

```cpp
form->setFieldGrowthPolicy(QFormLayout::AllNonFixedFieldsGrow);
```

`onSceneAdd` 和 `onSceneEdit` 都要加。方案 B 是单独给两个 combo 设 `Expanding`，不如 A 稳，因为 SpinBox 在 Breeze 下也可能偏窄。

同文件的「添加/编辑 LLM 提供者」对话框目前只有 `QLineEdit`/`QTextEdit`（默认 Expanding），Breeze 下不明显。但 `asr_provider_dialog.cpp`（类型/模型 combo）和 `control_page.cpp`（采集设备 combo）是同一模式，KDE 下可能也会窄。

Manage [Omarchy](https://omarchy.org/) Linux systems - a beautiful, modern, opinionated Arch Linux distribution with Hyprland.

This skill is for end-user customization on installed systems.
It is not for contributing to Omarchy source code.

# Capture and Sharing

Read this before taking screenshots or screen recordings, extracting text from
the screen, or sharing files with other machines.

## Screenshots

```bash
omarchy screenshot                            # Interactive smart-region flow
omarchy capture screenshot region             # Select a region
omarchy capture screenshot windows            # Pick a window
omarchy capture screenshot fullscreen save    # Full screen, straight to disk (no editor)
```

The first argument picks the mode (`smart|region|windows|fullscreen`), the
second what happens with it (`slurp|copy|save`). `save` skips the annotation
editor and prints the saved path. Screenshots land in the configured Pictures
directory (override with `OMARCHY_SCREENSHOT_DIR`).

## Screen Recording

```bash
omarchy screenrecord --fullscreen             # Start recording the full screen
# ...exercise whatever you want on film...
omarchy screenrecord --stop-recording         # Stop; prints the saved path
```

Optional flags: `--with-desktop-audio`, `--with-microphone-audio`,
`--with-webcam` (plus `--webcam-device=` and `--webcam-size=`), and
`--resolution=<size>`. Without `--fullscreen` a region picker opens first.
Recordings land in the configured Videos directory (override with
`OMARCHY_SCREENRECORD_DIR`). Resize a live webcam overlay with
`omarchy capture webcam resize <smaller|larger|reset|small|medium|large>`.

If recording fails to start, rerun with `OMARCHY_SCREENRECORD_DEBUG=true` to
collect a log at `/tmp/omarchy-screenrecord.log` worth attaching to a bug
report.

## Text Capture (OCR)

```bash
omarchy capture text    # Select a region; extracted text goes to the clipboard
```

## Sharing Files

```bash
omarchy share clipboard               # Share the clipboard via LocalSend
omarchy share file <path...>          # Share files with nearby devices
omarchy share folder <path>           # Share a folder

omarchy tailscale send <machine> <file...>    # Taildrop to a tailnet machine
omarchy tailscale receive [directory]         # Save incoming Taildrop files
```

Shrink large captures before sharing them:

```bash
omarchy transcode <input> [format] [resolution]   # Re-encode pictures/videos for sharing
```

查到了，不是 PipeWire 彻底坏了，而是**连锁反应导致的 Portal 悬空**。

### 原因排查

日志显示 `pipewire.service` 在 15:07（大约 50 分钟前）被重启过。

在 Hyprland (Wayland) 下，录屏走的链路是：
> 录屏工具（GPU Screen Recorder / OBS / wl-screenrec）→ `xdg-desktop-portal` → `xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland`（screencopy）→ PipeWire 视频流

当 PipeWire 被重启后，原本在后台常驻了 3 天的 Portal 服务不会自动重新握手，直接掉线了：
```text
Failed connect to PipeWire: No node factory discovered
Failed to close session implementation: 已到超时限制
```
所以录屏工具一申请屏幕流就会直接卡死或超时报错。

---

### 已自动修复

刚才已经帮你重新连接了 Portal 链条：
```bash
systemctl --user restart xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland xdg-desktop-portal-gtk xdg-desktop-portal
```

重启后日志已恢复正常握手：
```text
[LOG] [pipewire] connected
[LOG] [screencopy] init successful
```

`xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland` 和 `xdg-desktop-portal` 已经重新挂载回当前运行的 PipeWire 节点，音频和视频流拓扑都已正常。

你现在按录屏快捷键（或者试录一下）看看，应该已经恢复正常了。
